name: EasyParcel Shipping– All-in-one Shipping Solution, Real-Time Shipping Rates
author: EasyParcel

sections.description:
THE #1 ALL-IN-ONE WOOCOMMERCE SHIPPING SOLUTION WITH CHEAPEST COURIER OPTIONS & REAL-TIME SHIPPING RATES FOR MALAYSIA AND SINGAPORE

EasyParcel, the leading courier service booking platform in Malaysia and Singapore, makes your delivery easy — Delivery Made Easy!

Notice: Plugin enhancement in Version 1.0.22

✅ If you’re experiencing this issue, please update to the latest version, 1.0.22, which includes a fix and other improvements.
🚫 We strongly advise against using versions 1.0.18 to 1.0.21 to avoid potential disruptions.

To update, go to your WordPress Dashboard → Plugins → EasyParcel Shipping → Update, or download the latest version from the official repository.

🗝 Key Features

  • Cheapest Courier Option: Showcase affordable courier option at checkout to reduce shipping costs and enhance customer satisfaction.

  • Real-time Shipping Rates: Provide live shipping rates from EasyParcel, ensuring accurate pricing at checkout without manual updates.

  • Custom Shipping Rates: Empower tailored shipping rates for buyers, ensuring flexibility and control over costs.

  • Auto Bulk Order Fulfillment: Streamline bulk order fulfillment with preferred couriers, saving time and effort.

  • Custom Shipping Zone Setting: Configure unique shipping settings for different zones to optimize strategies based on location.

  • Free Shipping Conditions: Enable specific conditions for free shipping, encouraging larger purchases and boosting loyalty.

🌟 Extra Exclusive Features

  • 24/7 Quote and Book: Quote and book deliveries anytime, day or night.

  • 60+ Instant Rate Comparison: Compare 60+ courier rates instantly for the best deal.

  • End-to-end Tracking: Track your parcels from start to finish for peace of mind.

  • Custom Branding: Boost brand awareness with personalized shipping labels, tracking page, SMS, and email notifications.

  • Seamless Integration: Effortlessly integrates with 40+ platforms for quick setup and easy use.

  • Auto Topup: Automatically replenishes shipping credits to ensure uninterrupted service.

  • Pay As You Go: Start shipping with no minimum spend or subscription fees.

  • Tracking Number Notification: Sends automatic notifications to customers with tracking numbers for enhanced transparency.

  • Extra Parcel Protection: Offers additional coverage for shipments, minimizing the risk of loss.

  • Bulk Order Express: Accelerates the fulfillment process for large orders, ensuring timely delivery.

  • Proof of Delivery (ePOD): Provides verifiable confirmation of successful deliveries, enhancing accountability.

  • Auto-generated Shipping Labels: Create shipping labels instantly with minimal effort.

  • 1-on-1 Premium Support: Get expert help whenever you need it.

❤️ Why EasyParcel?

  • Enhances Customer Satisfaction: Access to the cheapest courier options ensures affordable shipping choices at checkout.

  • Increases Flexibility: Set custom shipping rates to meet diverse customer needs and preferences.

  • Saves Time and Effort: Automate bulk order fulfillment, allowing focus on business growth instead of manual processing.

  • Optimizes Shipping Strategies: Customize shipping zone settings to offer competitive rates based on geographic locations.

  • Encourages Larger Purchases: Set conditions for free shipping to boost average order value and foster customer loyalty.

  • Provides Accurate Pricing: Real-time shipping rates eliminate manual updates, enhancing trust and reducing cart abandonment.

  • Enhances Customer Satisfaction: Tracking number notifications keep customers informed, improving transparency and satisfaction.

  • Expedites Order Processing: Bulk Order Express accelerates the fulfillment of large orders, ensuring timely delivery for high-volume sales.

  • Effortless Setup: Seamless integration with 40+ platforms allow for quick and easy implementation without technical hassles.

  • Simplifies Account Management: Auto top-up functionality ensures uninterrupted service by automatically replenishing your shipping credits.

☎️ Support

Visit our website for more information and promotion.

For support inquiries, contact our team at support@easyparcel.com.
